player.name: Josh Hart
player.physicalDescription: 6'4" guard with a thick, muscular build, short dark hair, light beard and mustache, intense wide-eyed expression, wrists taped
player.archetype: The undersized dog who takes the ball from giants

fusion.wardrobe: a desert scout's rough woven mantle in earthy stripes of sand, rust, and olive, thrown back off his shoulders and whipping behind him in the jump, a leather scout's satchel strapped across his chest, and a grapevine wound around one taped wrist
fusion.accents: a few green grape leaves and tendrils curling around his sneakers
fusion.aura: another spirit - wild, joyful, fearless, the one scout who looked at the giants and said 'we can take them'
fusion.background: towering colossal giants shaped out of the mountains and storm clouds on both sides, looming over him like defenders but dwarfed by his leap; tiny bright-green grasshoppers hopping along the bottom edge; an enormous cluster of purple grapes hanging from a thick vine across the top of the frame, with pomegranates and figs tucked in the vine; the psychedelic drips in the skyline flow as golden honey and white milk; a rugged mountain rising directly behind him, its peak crowned with light; a faint constellation shaped like a loyal howling dog in the sky

figure.name: Caleb
figure.attributeDescription: the giant cluster of grapes the scouts carried back from the Promised Land on a pole
figure.visualStyle: Israelite scout and warrior from the tribe of Judah
figure.clothing: desert scout's woven mantle over a simple tunic, leather satchel
figure.physicalDescription: rugged, weathered scout, strong at any age, fierce joyful eyes
figure.archetype: The faithful scout who wasn't afraid of the giants

connection.thematic: Ten scouts saw giants and felt like grasshoppers. Caleb saw grapes. Hart sees seven-footers and sees rebounds.
connection.narrative: Caleb's name sounds like 'kelev' - dog. Hart is the dog in every big game.

scripture.hebrew: וְעַבְדִּי כָלֵב עֵקֶב הָיְתָה רוּחַ אַחֶרֶת עִמּוֹ וַיְמַלֵּא אַחֲרָי וַהֲבִיאֹתִיו אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־בָּא שָׁמָּה וְזַרְעוֹ יוֹרִשֶׁנָּה׃
scripture.english: But My servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed Me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

connection.receipt: +200 total plus-minus in the 2026 playoffs, third-best in the league; won the 2026 title alongside his Villanova teammates Brunson and Bridges

interactions.description: Josh Hart and Caleb standing together as equals
